basic_steps: Form a trio with one male and two female dancers.
Begin moving in sync from the same foot.
Male dancer partners with one female while the other dances alone.
Switch female partners with the male dancer.
Perform rolling movements on and off the male's arms.
Form a circle and move together.
Separate and move in opposite directions, then rejoin.
